ffxiii2-nx package rc9 (2026-11-07): build k240 (the same sources as the PC build k240pc).

WHAT CHANGED SINCE rc8
1. The opening cutscene on the Switch (D-010): no more single frames with the 3D scene black and only the subtitles
   left (the flicker you still saw on rc8; rc8 did fix the face, D-009).
   Cause: the game uses one surface description in two roles - the scene's depth buffer and, rewritten in place, the
   colour buffer of its final post-processing passes. The Xbox 360 takes the description when it is bound; the
   renderer read it later on its own thread. The Switch's renderer runs further behind the game than the PC's, so it
   sometimes read the description after the game had already switched it back to the depth role for the next frame,
   and dropped that frame's final composite draws (the copies of the result still went to the screen: black with the
   subtitles). Now that description is also taken at bind time in its colour role, as the 360 does. Frames that were
   right before are drawn exactly as before.
2. Same fixes as rc8 (D-009 face, D-008 battle flicker).

STILL OPEN
- Rare crash when the game is started right after it was closed, and when a Frame Tap stream attaches during a load
  (D-006).
- The band at the top of some battle frames (D-003) is not re-measured on the Switch yet.

INSTALL: copy COPY_TO_SD_switch_ffxiii2-nx\ to sdmc:/switch/ffxiii2-nx/ (your saves in renut/ are not touched).
ROLL BACK: rc8 (Works\builds\2026-11-07_0559_ffxiii2_rc8) and rc7 are unchanged.
Credits: reNut's renderer (its author permits reuse), katamari-nx, renut-nx, sa2-nx, NetherSX2_nx, battd_nx,
bejeweled3-nx / zuma ports. GPL-3.0 where the sources are.
